remarks: Welcome to 47 Lafayette Place, where convenience meets comfort! This oversized one-bedroom rental is flooded with natural light, featuring large windows throughout and an airy, open feel. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers plenty of room for dining, while the generously sized bedroom provides a peaceful retreat.  Located just steps from Greenwich Hospital and vibrant Greenwich Avenue, you're within walking distance to the train, shops, restaurants, and the library. The building is impeccably maintained and constructed from solid concrete, ensuring exceptional soundproofing for a quiet living experience.  Enjoy the added perks of one assigned parking spot, an on-site gym, bike storage, and a private storage unit in the basement. Don't miss this rare opportunity to live in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations!  Available now-schedule your showing today!
